# Faultline

> Faultline is a control room for change on production lines. Every change to a line — new equipment, a line that has to perform better, a number that has to be hit — is run on the method that fits it, measured before and after, and shown in one view that answers "am I in control?" across every line and job. Offline-first, installable on the phones and laptops a team already has.

Faultline is made by OpEx Elevate (UK). It is invite-only — there is no public sign-up.

## The three methods — three kinds of change

- **Stage gate.** New equipment taken through its gates — Install, Set up, Commission, Hand over — with the supplier: install stages, tests against what was agreed, the fixes they raise, the materials and programs it waits on, and the handover date.
- **3P.** A running line improved week by week on the board, every action sorted People, Plant or Process, with an owner and a due date. Kept entirely in the app.
- **Lever tree.** One outcome worked down to what has to be true for it; each condition's colour follows its number or the work under it.

## Inside every change

- **A measured before and after**, judged against the line's own numbers — allowed to say not proven.
- **The plan as a live Gantt** that asks why a date moved and shows the knock-on.
- **Line balance**: every machine and person in one unit, the limit found, and what-ifs that show where the limit moves — and can be put on the board.
- **The line filmed on a phone**, faults pinned to the spot on the footage, each one a fix with an owner.
- **The control room**: every job across every method, what is late, and who owes what by when.
- **A client report** for each change — on screen and as a PDF — in the same words as the screens.

## What it is not

- Not a sensor or OEE system: people record what they see, and the app runs the change and proves it.
- Not a compliance or audit-checklist tool.
- No sensors, no integrations, no IT project.

## Key pages

- [Home / the app](https://faultline.opexelevate.co.uk/): sign-in.
- [How it works — real screens](https://faultline.opexelevate.co.uk/how-it-works.html): the control room and the three methods, screen by screen.

## Facts

- Audience: operations and engineering leads running several changes on production lines, who report to a general manager, a client or an equipment supplier.
- Platform: installable web app (PWA), offline-first, background sync; phones, tablets, laptops.
- Access: invite-only; a project's owner adds people by email.
